abstract: Owns the ASOME sprint cycle end to end: bootstraps a new project sprint structure from the ASOME canon (relevamiento + walking skeleton in S1, vertical slice in S2, +90-day comparative measurement), plans sprints under an hours-and-story-points capacity ceiling, moves issue stages, closes sprints with measurement and a retro artifact, reports velocity per lane, and audits UX-dev design lead time. Reads .asome/config.json; writes board fields, sprint plan docs and retro files.
